name: barbacue-diaries
description: BBQ cook journal — mobile PWA + Android app

scripts.mobile:copy: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www/icons && cp mobile/index.html mobile/styles.css mobile/app.js mobile/manifest.webmanifest mobile/sw.js www/ && cp mobile/icons/*.png www/icons/
scripts.android:sync: npm run mobile:copy && cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && cap open android
scripts.android:run: npm run android:sync && cap run android
